svg.title: API Integration: one business, five systems, one connected network
svg.desc: An order placed on a website travels through a central API connector, triggers payment capture, then updates the CRM, posts an invoice and sends a WhatsApp receipt, with each call logged in a developer console.

g.text: Customer places an order on the website
Charge request sent to the payment gateway
Payment captured · webhook returns to the hub
Order synced to CRM, Accounts & WhatsApp
